output.reason: [ev-96141bfb2be5] says the Rancher v1 provider was removed in v3. It shows the static-config key as providers.rancher (YAML/TOML) and says this configuration "is now unsupported and would prevent Traefik to start", so the subject and the removed type are right. The proposed replacedBy path "providers.kubernetes.crd" does not appear in the evidence. The remediation only advises Rancher 2.x users to use the Kubernetes CRD provider, which is a different provider rather than a renamed key, so replacedBy should be dropped.

correction.statement: The Rancher v1 provider static configuration key providers.rancher was removed in Traefik v3; configuration using it is unsupported and prevents Traefik from starting. Rancher 2.x users are advised to use the Kubernetes CRD provider instead.
